# Portfolio project sites

Project previews open the bundled static sites in a new tab. Run npm run build from the portfolio directory to copy these sites into dist/projects.

Sources: 프로젝트 1/worldwideworld/dist, 프로젝트 1/Lotus, 프로젝트 1/men-i-trust. These are independent snapshots; after editing the originals, copy their runtime files into the corresponding projects folder and rebuild. Keep assets, fonts and vendor directories alongside each index.html.
